title: U.S. Data Center Policy Tracker
headline: A continuously updated database of state, local, and utility actions affecting U.S. data-center development.
description: Zoning fights, moratoria, tax deals, tariffs and PUC dockets shaping where data centers get built. One row per government or utility action.
source_name: Compiled from primary government and utility records
method_note: Each row is a discrete action by a government body or regulated utility that affects data-center development: an ordinance, bill, docket order, tariff filing, or permit decision. Commentary, market news, and corporate announcements are excluded unless they trigger a government action. Rows are entered only against a primary source document. Absence of a row is not evidence that nothing happened; coverage of local actions is necessarily incomplete.
author: Shawn Regan

harvest._comment: Discovery queries. These find CANDIDATES, not facts. A human still reads the primary source before anything reaches events.csv.
queries: data center special use permit denied
data center large load tariff commission
public utility commission data center rate case
utility commission approves data center agreement
